lastCompletedStory.title: Audit versioning/release/update and support-channels dimensions, then write the go/no-go and ready-to-file gap triage

nextStoryContext: US-003 was the final story of this PRD (CAM-330): docs/launch-readiness.md is now complete with all 8 audited dimensions (distribution/install: gap, first-run onboarding: gap, external-facing docs: gap, security/secrets: gap, license/repo-visibility: ready, telemetry/privacy stance: gap, versioning/release/update-path: gap, support channels: gap), a summary table, a prioritized gap triage (post-CAM-54 codex-per-subagent product state, verified CAM-0054.json stage:shipped), an explicit NO-GO recommendation with a 4-item must-fix blocking set (bypassPermissions disclosure, CAM-331 README ship, packaged non-source install path, telemetry/privacy statement), and a Follow-up Issues section with ready-to-file specs (title + scope) for the orchestrator/operator to hand-file on main via /cam-issue per the CAM-162 defect rule (this story did NOT hand-file any scripts/cam/issues/CAM-XXXX.json itself, by design). No further implementer story remains in this PRD; the next action is review, then the orchestrator/operator filing the Follow-up Issues list on main. Facts verified directly rather than assumed: zero GitHub Releases published despite 252 pushed tags (`gh release list`), no cam update/self-update mechanism anywhere in src/, has_discussions:false and has_wiki:true-but-empty on the repo (`gh api repos/eduardocaminha/cam-cli`), no .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/CONTRIBUTING.md/SECURITY.md/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. Continuing US-002's discipline: re-verify, don't inherit, any stale-sounding premise in future work on this doc.
